facts.fact: Tunisia's return to UNESCO's 2024 SDG 16.10.2 survey names law no. 22 of 24 March 2016 as its access to information guarantee, with information officers required in all public bodies.

Tunisia's return to UNESCO's 2024 SDG 16.10.2 survey says a national information commission oversees the law, and reports 7,347 appeals received in January-December 2023 and 6,375 requests received in 2021.
